items.name: Minimum processor state
items.description: Minimum processor state controls cpu scheduler and frequency policy.
items.shortDescription: Minimum processor state controls cpu scheduler and frequency policy.
items.longDescription: Adjusts minimum processor state through cpu scheduler and frequency policy. Performance-oriented values reduce ramp delays but increase draw and heat.
items.whatItDoes: Writes and tracks minimum processor state so Falcon can apply, verify, and rollback consistently for this policy family.
items.whyGamersCare: It is mostly a power-behavior control and usually has limited direct gaming benefit.
items.fpsImpact: Primarily affects 1% low consistency; average FPS change is usually small to moderate.
items.latencyImpact: Direct end-to-end latency impact is usually low.
items.powerImpact: Higher-performance values increase package power and reduce idle savings.
items.heatImpact: Higher sustained clocks can raise temperature and fan noise under load.
items.stabilityRisk: Low to medium when changed within documented value ranges.
items.recommendedFor: Users tuning a stable daily gaming profile.
items.avoidIf: Avoid if you cannot benchmark changes or need strict OEM-default behavior.
